protocol: 500 single-seed exploration trials, top 12 re-ranked at 3 seeds; winner picked on the 3-seed mean

held_out_confirmation.verdict: REJECTED. The +0.0161 measured on the tuning window did not survive on any held-out window (mean -0.0015 over three). Two distinct selection biases were at work: seed-luck, worth +0.0090 and removed by re-ranking the top 12 at three seeds, and window-luck -- 500 trials selecting on one 8-gameweek block overfit that block. Only out-of-sample scoring exposes the second. v10 hyperparameters are retained; the tuned values are kept here as a record, not for use.
